name: THE ROLL
introduce: Start with lying on your back, and extend your arms out to the sides. \n\nBend your knees to the chest, and lift your legs up toward the ceiling. Then lower your legs and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Keep your legs together all the time.
Keep your feet off the floor.
Inhale when you lower your legs and exhale when you lift up.
You should feel your lower abs burning.
This exercise works on your abs.
